messages:
jamie (eng-rel): Quick pulse for today's release train — important schedule change:
- We're extending the release freeze window to 15:45-17:30 UTC (was 16:00-16:45) to accommodate a staged embeddings canary and extra validation.
- Canary will rollout to a small batch of customers (tagged `emb-canary-small`) in us-east first. EU will remain on hold pending latency stabilization.
- Please DO NOT merge any non-exception PRs until 17:30 UTC. If you need an exception, include `release-exception` and ping @jamie + @dave.

sarah (pm): Reason for extension? Any customer-facing note?

jamie (eng-rel): We found a checksum mismatch in the serialized embedding tables during internal validation. It seems to impact only quantized tables produced by `embedgen` v0.9. Affected models will be retagged and re-uploaded. No API changes. We'll post a short banner if we hit any visible regressions.

qa-runner: Running validation suite now on the canary cohort: `tests/embeddings/consistency` with 3k samples. ETA ~25m.

dave (infra): Rolling back any partial uploads is painful; we'll instead run a hot-fix that re-validates the table checksums on ingest and rejects bad uploads with a clearer error. Deploy during freeze.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: `embeddings-canary-2026-03-24` -> 2% traffic (us-east) at 2026-03-24T15:50:00Z

sre-oncall: Note: eu-west storage cluster shows higher tail I/O at the moment. I'm throttling EU canary until we see consistent IO metrics. Will update when under threshold.

jamie (eng-rel): For those running local tests, use:
```
python tools/validate_embedding_table.py --input /tmp/table.bin --check-sums
```
If it fails, please don't re-upload; file a ticket to infra with the output.

qa-runner: First pass shows 0.12% checksum failures on the synthetic set. Digging into which model builds produced them now.

sarah (pm): If rollback becomes necessary, what's the plan? Customers impacted?

dave (infra): Rollback plan: revert the ingestion tag and cut traffic to pre-embedgen builds using routing policy `fallback-pre-embedgen`. Command:
```
redwood route set --policy fallback-pre-embedgen --train release-train-2026-03-24
```
Minimal customer impact expected because we'll only fallback affected customer routes.

jamie (eng-rel): Thanks all. We'll reconvene at 17:10 UTC for a go/no-go. If you need a merge exception, ping here with the PR link and reason. Will post a summary after the freeze (:memo:).
